name: Gujarat Containers Ltd
tagline: Microcap steel-barrel / drum maker — historically high ROE but recent margins compressing and profit declining year-on-year, no catalyst
business_overview: Gujarat Containers Ltd manufactures mild-steel barrels, drums and containers used for packaging chemicals, lubricants and food products. Microcap (~Rs 96 Cr) on BSE.
fundamentals_table: 5-yr average ROE ~24.6% / 5-yr average ROCE ~24.3%; latest half-year ROCE ~14.7% (lowest in the trailing period)
Q3 FY26 PAT ~Rs 2.0 Cr: +48% QoQ but -9% YoY; operating margin 10.5% -> 9.1% YoY
Low debt; historically stretched working-capital days
fundamentals_narrative: The multi-year averages look strong (ROE/ROCE ~24%) but the recent trend is the wrong way: Q3 FY26 profit was down ~9% YoY despite a QoQ bounce, operating margins compressed to ~9%, and latest ROCE is the lowest in the trailing window. Independent commentary framed the quarter as 'modest revenue growth masks profitability concerns'. This is a commodity-adjacent steel-conversion business with limited pricing power and low structural growth.
